title: Aayiye ab karbala me hogaye tanha hussain
body:
ya mohammed mustafa ya ali sher e khuda
aaiye ab karbala me hogaye tanha hussain
har khadam par shaahe dee'n ke gham ka ek toofan hai
laarahe hain ran se phir bhi ek jawa'n lasha hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
fatima zehra tadpkar shimr se kehti rahi
na sitam kar bhooka pyaasa hai mera bachcha hussain
aalam e ghurbat hai koi monis o yawar nahi
zaalimo'n ke darmiya'n hai dilbar e zehra hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
dijiye aakar dilasa fatima ke laal ko
dasht e ghurbat me hai pyaasa aapka beta hussain
chalgaya pyaase gale par kund khanjar shimr ka
hai tadapta khaak par ye aapka pyaara hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ye gham e shabbir hamse na baya'n hoga fida
bas khuda hi jaanta hai gham sahe kya kya hussain
